title: Lock files or folders to prevent changes
summary: Use the chflags command with the 'uchg' flag to make files or folders read-only. This prevents accidental deletion or modification, even by the owner.

aliases.text: защитить файл от удаления на маке

steps.explain: Run chflags with the -R (recursive) and uchg flags to lock a directory and all its contents.

placeholders.name: DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: Path to the directory to lock

rollback.explain: Run chflags with the -R (recursive) and nouchg flags to unlock the directory and its contents.

placeholders.name: DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: Path to the directory to unlock

warnings: Locked files cannot be modified or deleted until unlocked.
You must use the rollback command to unlock files before editing them.
